extra.reason: Subsumed: the unified trigger rule (canonical ≠ cf → trigger) eliminates the need for a separate canonical-excluded check. The cf fleet can't dispatch an excluded car, so canonical dispatching an excluded car always produces X≠Y naturally. Testing absorbed into 89g and d3i.

Threaded current action threshold_a through _ghost_step → check_ghost_triggers instead of using stored per-ghost ghost_threshold. Both canonical and cf fleets now use the same threshold at each timestep, isolating car-state divergence. ghost_threshold kept in state for logging only.

Refactored ghost state from per-ghost to per-group storage. EnvState now has group-level arrays (group_origin_step, group_active, group_excluded_cars, etc.) plus contiguous ghost slot blocks per group. EnvParams uses max_groups + max_ghosts_per_group instead of max_ghosts + ghost_max_branch_depth. Ghost creation via single create_ghost_group function. Fixed exclusion mask -1 wrap-around bug. All 19 tests pass including oracle.
Contiguous block allocation was implemented as part of or-gymnax-toc. Group g owns slots [g*max_ghosts_per_group, (g+1)*max_ghosts_per_group). No separate ghost_slot_write_idx needed.
